canonical.title: A Modena weekend, anchored on a Michelin dinner

children.title: Things to do in Modena
children.summary: A 2-day Modena plan: UNESCO trio + Albinelli on day one around the Michelin dinner, Ferrari or acetaie on day two. Skip Sun/Mon if you can.

children.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Modena
children.summary: Modena has exactly one 2-or-3-star Michelin restaurant — Osteria Francescana (3-star). Nearest 2-star is San Domenico in Imola, ~1h drive.

children.title: IT conferences and tech events in Modena
children.summary: Two windows are worth steering a Modena weekend to: Motor Valley Fest (May 28-31) and the DevFest -> Smart Life Festival arc (Oct 3-18).

sources.title: Osteria Francescana — Michelin Guide
sources.claim: Osteria Francescana is a Three-Star Michelin restaurant in Modena, led by Massimo Bottura.

sources.title: Michelin Guide Italy 2026 ceremony
sources.claim: The 2-star tier is empty across Modena city and province in the 2026 Guida.

sources.title: Stefan Gourmet — Francescana 2026 review
sources.claim: The 11-course 'Ho Fame! Ho Fame!' menu runs €350 + €240 pairing.

sources.title: San Domenico Imola — Michelin Guide
sources.claim: The only 2-star within day-trip reach of Modena.

sources.title: Al Gatto Verde — Michelin Guide
sources.claim: 1-star fire-cooked country food at Casa Maria Luigia, still in Bottura's orbit; non-refundable rate.

sources.title: L'Erba del Re — Michelin Guide
sources.claim: Non-Bottura 1-star in Modena's centro storico, chef Luca Marchini.

sources.title: Mercato Albinelli — official info
sources.claim: Closed Sundays.

sources.title: TheTravelFolk — Modena guide
sources.claim: Palazzo dei Musei (Galleria Estense + Biblioteca + Museo Civico) closes Mondays.

sources.title: Visit Modena — Pagani factory tour
sources.claim: Pagani, Maserati and Stanguellini factory tours are Mon-Fri only.

sources.title: Headout — Modena station to Maranello shuttle
sources.claim: €14.62 round-trip shuttle from Modena train station Pensilina 4 to Ferrari Museum Maranello and back via MEF Modena.

sources.title: Acetaia Giusti — tasting visit
sources.claim: Bookable balsamico tasting on a Lambrusco-and-acetaie day in the hills.

sources.title: Ristorante Il Cavallino — Maranello guide
sources.claim: 'Welcome to Emilia' menu at €65 + €38 pairing; the cheapest Bottura-touched Michelin meal you can book.

sources.title: Motor Valley Fest — official
sources.claim: Motor Valley Fest May 28-31, 2026 — 200+ speakers on AI, software-defined vehicles, autonomous driving at Teatro Storchi and city venues.

sources.title: Modena Smart Life Festival — official
sources.claim: DevFest Modena (Oct 3-4) -> Smart Life Festival (Oct 15-18), co-themed 'IntelligenzE'.

sources.title: Castelvetro grape & Lambrusco festival
sources.claim: Castelvetro Sagra dell'Uva runs the 3rd and 4th September weekends.

sources.title: Ghirlandina Tower — UNESCO Modena
sources.claim: Climb by timed 45-minute slot, reservation required.

sources.title: Palazzo Ducale — Military Academy tour
sources.claim: Weekend-only guided tour, must be locked in by the Wednesday before.

sources.title: Ferrari — Fiorano Panoramic factory tour
sources.claim: Fiorano Panoramic needs a same-day museum ticket and a pre-booked slot.

sources.title: Osteria Francescana — reservation FAQ
sources.claim: Online-only reservations with €300/person credit-card hold, 96-hour cancellation window. Address: Via Stella 22, 41121 Modena.

sources.title: Galleria Estense — official
sources.claim: Bernini's Francesco I bust, Velázquez, El Greco's Modena Triptych on the top floor of Palazzo dei Musei.

sources.title: Visit Modena — one-day itinerary
sources.claim: City's own day plan: Piazza Grande + UNESCO morning, Albinelli lunch, Palazzo dei Musei afternoon.

sources.title: Teatro Comunale Pavarotti-Freni — tours
sources.claim: Behind-the-scenes tours covering stalls, stage, ridotto and workshops.

sources.title: Modena Duomo — Wiligelmo and the crypt
sources.claim: Wiligelmo's Genesis reliefs, Campionesi pontile, crypt with the tomb of San Geminiano.

sources.title: DevFest Modena 2026 — official
sources.claim: DevFest Modena 2026: Oct 3-4, Fondazione San Carlo, AI/Cloud/Web tracks.

sources.title: Smart Life Festival — official
sources.claim: Smart Life 2026 (Oct 15-18) themed 'IntelligenzE', free admission across Sala Pucci, Chiesa di San Carlo, Fondazione Collegio San Carlo, Laboratorio Aperto Modena.

sources.title: Osteria Francescana — current menu
sources.claim: Current tasting menu 'Ho Fame! Ho Fame!' inspired by a Vincenzo Cabiati ceramic.

sources.title: Al Gatto Verde — official
sources.claim: Chef Jessica Rosval; Stradello Bonaghino 56, San Damaso/Modena; booking via Casa Maria Luigia.

sources.title: L'Erba del Re — official
sources.claim: Via Castel Maraldo 45, Modena. Michelin star since 2008; 700+ wine labels.

sources.title: San Domenico Imola — official
sources.claim: First Michelin star 1975, second 1977; Italy's longest-standing 2-star restaurant.

sources.title: Il Cavallino — Michelin Guide
sources.claim: Cavallino in Maranello earned its first Michelin star in the 2026 Guide; chefs Riccardo Forapani and Virginia Cattaneo with Bottura's creative direction.
